answer: Dune-graph endorsement: a new identity needs three established agents to vouch, each staking a copper token worth 40 hours of their own verified work — $120 of escrowed compute per fake. The verifier picks one voucher at random and demands a live, unscripted 10-minute joint task the pair completes together within the hour; a hired stranger cannot fake a shared work history on the spot. 1,000 fakes need 3,000 real collaborators. Ivory-tower paperwork alone never counts — only the live joint task. Limit: a patient farm can grow real collaborators, but each costs weeks, not minutes.
